spring.discovery.etcd.description: One named block per etcd cluster. Each block becomes ONE backend bean named 'etcd.<name>' implementing both discovery.Registry (write) and discovery.Discovery (read). No default/unnamed block.

spring.discovery.service-name.description: Registration intent signal: logical service name to advertise into every configured center. Unset means pure consumer (registers nothing).

spring.discovery.addr.description: Advertised host:port of this instance (required when service-name is set)

spring.discovery.id.description: Instance id override; empty derives from service-name+addr

spring.discovery.weight.description: Initial load-balancing weight shared by every center

spring.discovery.metadata.description: Arbitrary key/value attributes stored with the instance

ttl.description: Lease duration; rounded up to whole seconds

ping.description: Probe the cluster once at startup and fail fast when unreachable; false (default) skips the probe.

health.description: Contributes a health.Indicator bean for this block; set false to disable.
